values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in access to the lake (amenity table: C).

values.note: 10 'tent and small trailer' sites (the DNR's standard state forest wording). The current DNR page posts no maximum length; the stored 40-ft figure (two sites) came from earlier note prose. One camping unit and six people per site.

note: Small rustic state forest campground on the north shore of Lake Marjory (bass and panfish), 11.9 mi S of Gaylord via Old Highway 27 South and Cottonwood Road (Otsego County); managed by Otsego Lake State Park. Otsego Lake is 4 mi north. --Claude
